findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. If main adds an invalid Forge Python module while app.py also conflicts, no conflicted path is under the running Forge package, so this line calls sync.files. Its module scan raises SyntaxError; close then reports “invalid syntax” and tells the worker only to rerun close, without naming app.py. The broken-main proof covers only a generated-file conflict, leaving this named case untested.
